content: Similarity-based approaches. We exploit the textual content of e-books (i.e., description or title) to recommend relevant tags BIBREF10 . For this, we first employ a content-based filtering approach BIBREF11 based on TF-IDF BIBREF12 to find top- INLINEFORM0 similar e-books. For each of the similar e-books, we then either extract the assigned editor tags (= INLINEFORM2 and INLINEFORM3 ) or the Amazon search terms (= INLINEFORM4 and INLINEFORM5 ). To combine the tags of the top- INLINEFORM6 similar e-books, we use the cross-source algorithm BIBREF13 , which favors tags that were used to annotate more than one similar e-book (i.e., tags that come from multiple recommendation sources). The final tag relevancy is calculated as: DISPLAYFORM0
